scope: Partial civilianroad history and selected India-specific Thar/Roxx versions. Not exhaustive.
gaps: Many exact production dates remain null; launch dates not relabelled production.
Sam’s museum indexed extracts used; individual MM540 page currently private, no login attempted.
EarlyCJ/CL identity grouped; non-road military vehicles, tractors, buses and Roxoroffroad-only excluded.
Marshal,Legend,Savari,Scorpiopickups/BoleroPik-Up,Maxximo/Supro/JeetoandotherLCVs deferred; no claim of all history.
Five selectedversions only; mass/0–100/consumption missing because chosen sheets did not settle them.
e2o/e2oPlus/eVerito/REVA/eSupro are delegated to MahindraElectric; modernBE/XEV retained here per root integration split.

checks: Strict TypeScript CatalogModelCard[] and CatalogModelLine[] assignment
Unique slugs, source URLs, chronological bounds, all null fields indexed in needsReview

photoScope: Selected full-car candidate thumbnails individually inspected; Commons category/subcategory and exactfilename search, precise imageinfo author/licence. Preferred aspect1.4–1.7. Bolero has explicit high-angle fallback. Null photos are incomplete research, not unavailability proof.
